# Edgecom Design System

> The design system for Edgecom Energy's product UI (dataTrack™, pTrack®, NeuraCharge™) — an energy management & monitoring platform. A public shadcn component registry plus a design language documented for both humans and agents. This file routes you to the right document; read the one that matches your task before generating UI.

## Guides

- [design.md](https://design.edgecom.ai/design.md): The design language and usage rules — colors/tokens, typography, layout, elevation, shape, per-component conventions, and accessibility. Read this before designing or generating any Edgecom UI.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/edgecom-ai/design-system/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Building an app **with** the design system — installing components from the registry, composing primitives, token sync, responsiveness. The "how to implement".
- [REGISTRY.md](https://github.com/edgecom-ai/design-system/blob/main/REGISTRY.md): Registry install mechanics in depth — the install address, the `theme` item, and how dependencies are inferred.
- [MAINTAINERS.md](https://github.com/edgecom-ai/design-system/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md): Developing the design-system repo itself — authoring primitives, tuning tokens, the Next.js docs site, and the registry build.
- [changelog.md](https://design.edgecom.ai/changelog.md): What changed and when — every release, generated from the commit history, with the registry items each change touched. Check it before assuming an API or token still looks the way you remember.

Browse every component in light/dark with copyable code at [design.edgecom.ai](https://design.edgecom.ai) — the source of truth for what exists. The full catalog:

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://design.edgecom.ai/getting-started/introduction/): A design system for building cohesive, data-dense, energy applications
- [Installation](https://design.edgecom.ai/getting-started/installation/): Everything you need to install the Edgecom design system and start building with it.
- [Accessibility](https://design.edgecom.ai/getting-started/accessibility/): Contrast, scalable type, and balancing accessibility with visual design.
- [Changelog](https://design.edgecom.ai/getting-started/changelog/): Every release of the design system, generated from the commit history.

## Foundations

- [Semantic colors](https://design.edgecom.ai/foundations/colors/): Semantic color tokens that adapt automatically between light and dark themes.
- [Chart ramp](https://design.edgecom.ai/foundations/charts/): Categorical hues and sequential tint ramps for charting each commodity.
- [Typography](https://design.edgecom.ai/foundations/typography/): The type scale, tabular figures, and heading styles used across the platform.
- [Logo](https://design.edgecom.ai/foundations/logo/): The Edgecom wordmark and glyph, with clear-space and color guidance.
- [Icons](https://design.edgecom.ai/foundations/icons/): Lucide icons — sizing conventions and usage.

## Components

- [Button](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/button/): Trigger actions with a range of variants, sizes, and icon layouts.
- [Input](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/input/): Single-line text fields with labels, icons, add-ons, and validation states.
- [List](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/list/): Structured lists for content, settings, and navigation.
- [Card](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/card/): A flexible container with header, content, and footer regions.
- [Badge & status tags](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/badge/): Compact labels for statuses, counts, and commodity tags.
- [Alert](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/alert/): Inline messages that communicate status, warnings, and errors.
- [Dialog](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/dialog/): Modal dialogs for confirmations, forms, and focused tasks.
- [Dropdown menu](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/dropdown-menu/): Menus of actions and options triggered from a button.
- [Context menu](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/context-menu/): A menu of actions revealed by right-clicking (or long-pressing) a target region.
- [Navigation menu](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/navigation-menu/): Horizontal top-level navigation with dropdown panels for links, features, and calls to action.
- [Resizable](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/resizable/): Draggable panel groups for building split views and master–detail layouts.
- [Empty state](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/empty/): A composable zero-state layout for empty lists, no-results searches, and first-run screens.
- [Drawer](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/drawer/): Panels that slide in from any edge of the screen.
- [Breadcrumb](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/breadcrumb/): Shows the user's location within a nested hierarchy.
- [Label & textarea](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/label-textarea/): Multi-line text input paired with accessible labels.
- [Spinner](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/spinner/): Indeterminate loading indicators for in-progress work.
- [Skeleton](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/skeleton/): Placeholder shapes that stand in for content while it loads.
- [Switch](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/switch/): Toggle a single setting on or off.
- [Toggle](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/toggle/): Buttons that hold a pressed state, individually or as a group.
- [Slider](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/slider/): Select a numeric value or range by dragging along a track.
- [Sortable](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/sortable/): Drag-and-drop lists and boards for reordering items.
- [Stepper](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/stepper/): Guide users through a sequence of steps in a process.
- [Progress](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/progress/): Communicate the completion of a task or a determinate value.
- [Avatar](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/avatar/): A user or contact image with a text fallback and grouping.
- [Field](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/field/): Label, description, and error scaffolding for form controls.
- [Input group](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/input-group/): Attach icons, text, or buttons to an input.
- [Scroll area](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/scroll-area/): A scrollable region with a styled scrollbar.
- [Separator](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/separator/): A thin divider for separating content, horizontally or vertically.
- [Sheet](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/sheet/): A dialog panel that slides in from an edge of the screen.
- [Select](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/select/): Choose one or more options from a dropdown list.
- [Banner](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/banner/): A full-width announcement bar for promotions, events, and product news.
- [Accordion](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/accordion/): Collapsible sections that expand to reveal their content.
- [Collapsible](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/collapsible/): A single region that toggles between shown and hidden.
- [Calendar](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/calendar/): Date selection for scheduling, pricing, and pickers.
- [Date picker](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/date-picker/): A calendar in a popover, triggered by an input, for selecting a single date or a range.
- [Category bar](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/category-bar/): A segmented proportion bar with an optional marker.
- [Command](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/command/): A searchable command palette for fast navigation and actions.
- [Pagination](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/pagination/): Page navigation controls for long lists and tables.
- [Sidebar](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/sidebar/): A composable application sidebar with header, grouped menu, and footer.
- [Table](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/table/): A styled HTML table for tabular data.
- [Timeline](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/timeline/): A vertical sequence of events with status dots and connectors.
- [Checkbox](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/checkbox/): Select one or many options, with grouped and indeterminate states.
- [Combobox](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/combobox/): A searchable select for choosing from long option lists.
- [Tags](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/tags-input/): A free-text field that turns typed values into removable tags — no option list required.
- [Button group](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/button-group/): Related buttons joined into a single control.
- [Tabs](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/tabs/): Switch between related views within the same context.
- [Popover](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/popover/): Floating panels anchored to a trigger for forms and details.
- [Radio group](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/radio-group/): Choose exactly one option from a set.
- [Tooltip](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/tooltip/): Contextual hints and rich previews shown on hover.
- [Toast](https://design.edgecom.ai/components/toast/): Brief, dismissible notifications for feedback and events.

## Blocks

- [Authorization](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/authorization/): A connection-progress screen for OAuth-style utility linking flows.
- [Detail dialog](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/detail-dialog/): Composed, opinionated dialogs that assemble many primitives into a full editing screen.
- [Charts](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/chart-blocks/): Prebuilt chart blocks themed with the commodity color ramps.
- [Data table](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/datatable/): Full-featured tables with sorting, filtering, pagination, and selection.
- [Form](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/form/): Composed form layouts, from single-step to multi-step wizards.
- [Page header](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/page-header/): A breadcrumb above the H1, plus optional tab and toolbar rows. Any crumb — including the current page — can open a dropdown to pivot between peers.
- [File upload](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/file-upload/): Drag-and-drop and browse controls for uploading files.
- [Statistic Cards](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/statistics/): Metric tiles and KPI blocks for dashboards.
- [Widgets](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/widgets/): Composed dashboard widgets combining stats, charts, and lists.
- [Application shell](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/application-shell/): The full page frame — sidebar, top bar, and content layout.
- [Settings](https://design.edgecom.ai/blocks/settings/): Account settings pages plus the settings shell that frames them with a grouped sub-nav.

<!-- @@GENERATED:catalog-end -->

## Notes

- Install a component: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add edgecom-ai/design-system/<name>` (the repo is the registry — no server or auth).
- The catalog above is generated from the docs-site sections (`src/app/sections.tsx`) — it lists every documented page.
